name: TracingBuffer
purpose: Thread-safe in-memory ring buffer of the last N request traces. Supports newest-first iteration, lookup by request id, and p99 slow-path query. Designed for in-process diagnostic UIs, NOT durable storage.
api_signature: class TracingBuffer: record(...), get_all(...), get_by_id(...), get_slow(...)
invariants: TRACING_BUFFER_INV_01: Buffer length MUST never exceed `maxlen`; oldest entries are evicted FIFO once the ring is full (deque-with-maxlen semantics).
TRACING_BUFFER_INV_02: `get_all()` MUST return entries in newest-first order (reverse of insertion).
TRACING_BUFFER_INV_03: `get_by_id(id)` MUST return the stored dict iff an entry with matching `id` is still in the buffer; else None (no exceptions).
